title: Sandbox balance assertions race with gas refunds when using max_gas()
summary: Prepaid gas from `.max_gas()` is refunded asynchronously, so a balance read right after a transaction can be off by up to about 1 NEAR and the refund lands later. This check is a heuristic: it fires on test files that use `.max_gas()`, read a balance and contain an assert, without proving the assert depends on that balance. Severity is info because a scan of public repos found roughly a third of hits in a small sample were unrelated reads.
message: {file}:{line} uses `.max_gas()` and asserts on balances; the refund may not have landed yet.

steps: Attach explicit gas (about 60 Tgas) instead of `.max_gas()`.
Allow a small gas tolerance in balance assertions.
fix.agent: In {file} at line {line}, replace `.max_gas()` with explicit gas (for example `.gas(Gas::from_tgas(60))`, importing `near_workspaces::types::Gas`), call `worker.fast_forward(5).await?` before reading balances, and allow a small gas tolerance in the balance assertions.

evidence.observed: Reproduced 2026-11-13 (macOS 15 arm64, rustc 1.100.0, cargo-near 0.23.0, near-sdk 5.30.1, node 26.12.1): with max_gas the borrower balance delta read 11.0007 NEAR instead of 10 NEAR right after the transaction; explicit 60 Tgas plus fast_forward(5) gave stable results.
